hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Connected groups of active cells can be grouped together with their component identifiers.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Label each connected component of 1s with a unique identifier and compute its total size.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: For each empty cell 0, evaluate the sum of sizes of distinct adjacent components plus 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Visits each grid cell a constant number of times during component labeling and neighbor aggregation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running breadth searches from every zero cell results in O(n^4) worst-case time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores component labels and sizes in an n by n table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Labels components first to aggregate neighboring component sizes in O(1).
